standards.label: Standards and ADRs
standards.note: null = omit workspace_id, search all accessible workspaces including Global

amplify-backend.description: Amplify Gen1 backend in amplify/backend/ — AppSync API + override.ts, function CloudFormation templates and parameters.json, custom CFN stacks
queries: AppSync GraphQL API authorization modes and private API standards
least-privilege IAM policy patterns for Lambda execution roles
Lambda VPC networking security group and egress patterns
resource naming conventions and environment parameterization

lambda.description: Lambda handler source in amplify/backend/function/*/src (Python 3.13 and Node 22)
queries: Lambda handler standards by invocation type API Gateway event-driven internal worker
Lambda error handling retry semantics and partial batch failure
structured logging and container-scope client initialization

deployment.description: CloudFormation stacks, CodeBuild buildspec and shell deploy scripts in deployment/
queries: infrastructure as code version pinning standards
least-privilege IAM patterns for CI build roles
UI ingress internal ALB private VPC no WAF

container.description: UI container image (Dockerfile, nginx config) served on ECS Fargate
queries: Fargate container UI service internal ALB standards
container image pinning and non-root runtime

frontend.description: React SPA in src/ using aws-amplify Auth and API
queries: React component structure and state management standards
frontend API client and error surface conventions

docs.description: ADRs in docs/adr and operator documentation in docs/
queries: ADR authoring format and when a decision warrants an ADR
